questions.question: Can I cancel anytime?
questions.answer: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time from your settings page. Your access continues until the end of your current billing period.

questions.question: What happens to my channel data if I cancel?
questions.answer: Your data remains accessible for 30 days after cancellation. You can export everything during that period. After 30 days, all data is permanently deleted per our data retention policy.

questions.question: Do you own my content?
questions.answer: Absolutely not. You retain 100% ownership of all content — scripts, thumbnails, videos, and any other creative assets produced through OUM.

questions.question: How does the AI produce videos?
questions.answer: Our AI generates scripts, voiceovers, visual elements, and edits them together using professional editing algorithms. Every video goes through your approval before publishing.

questions.question: Can I edit the AI's output before approval?
questions.answer: Yes. Every script, thumbnail, and video draft is fully editable. The AI creates the first version, and you have complete control to modify anything before approving.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: OUM ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our platform.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information you provide directly: account information (email, name, profile picture via Google OAuth), YouTube channel data (channel ID, title, subscriber count, video metadata), and niche preferences. We automatically collect usage analytics (pages visited, features used, session duration) and device information (browser type, operating system, IP address) for security and service improvement.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your data is used to: provide and maintain the OUM service, personalize AI-generated content strategies, analyze platform usage to improve features, communicate service updates and support responses, and ensure platform security and prevent abuse. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.

sections.heading: YouTube Data & API Services
sections.content: When you connect your YouTube channel, we access your data through the YouTube Data API in compliance with Google's API Services Terms of Service. We only access the minimum data necessary: channel information, video metadata, and analytics. We use this data solely to provide our content management services. You can revoke API access at any time from your dashboard settings.

sections.heading: Data Protection
sections.content: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest (AES-256). We maintain SOC 2 compliant infrastructure, implement strict access controls, and conduct regular security audits. OAuth tokens are stored encrypted and never exposed to client-side code.

sections.heading: Data Retention & Deletion
sections.content: Active account data is retained while your account is active. Upon account closure, all personal data is permanently deleted within 30 days. Channel analytics data may be retained in anonymized form for aggregate service improvement. You can request immediate full data deletion at any time by contacting oren.on.oren.25@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to: access all personal data we hold about you, correct any inaccurate data, request complete deletion of your data, export your data in a portable format, and opt out of non-essential data collection. Exercise these rights by contacting our privacy team.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.content: We may update this policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated via email and in-app notification at least 30 days before taking effect. Continued use after changes take effect constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to OUM. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully.

sections.heading: Service Description
sections.content: OUM provides an AI-powered platform for YouTube channel management. Our service includes automated content research, script writing, thumbnail generation, video production assistance, publishing, and performance optimization. The AI operates autonomously based on your configured preferences; you retain approval authority over all published content.

sections.heading: Account & Eligibility
sections.content: You must be at least 18 years old to use OUM. You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and for all activities that occur under your account. You must provide accurate and complete information during registration and keep your account information updated.

sections.heading: Subscription & Payment
sections.content: Paid plans are billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis. All prices are in USD. Subscriptions automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the renewal date. You may cancel at any time from your account settings.

sections.heading: Content Ownership
sections.content: You retain full ownership of all content created through OUM, including scripts, thumbnails, videos, and metadata. We claim no intellectual property rights over your content. By using the service, you grant us a limited license to process your content solely for the purpose of providing the service.

sections.heading: Acceptable Use
sections.content: You agree not to: use the platform for any unlawful purpose, generate content that violates YouTube's Community Guidelines, attempt to reverse-engineer or exploit the AI systems, share account credentials with unauthorized parties, or use automated means to access the platform outside provided APIs. Violation may result in immediate account suspension.

sections.heading: Limitation of Liability
sections.content: OUM is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from use of the platform. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim. We do not guarantee specific growth results or channel performance.

sections.heading: Termination
sections.content: Either party may terminate this agreement at any time. Upon termination, your access to the platform ceases immediately. We will provide a 30-day window for data export following termination. Sections regarding content ownership, limitation of liability, and dispute resolution survive termination.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: At OUM, customer satisfaction and trust are our top priorities. This policy explains how refund requests are handled for our subscriptions.

sections.heading: Refund Requests
sections.content: If you experience a billing issue or an accidental charge, contact our support team and we will review your request fairly and respond promptly.

sections.heading: Annual Subscription Renewal Refunds
sections.content: For annual plan renewals, you may request a full refund within 7 business days following the renewal charge date if you did not intend to renew.

sections.heading: Refund Processing & Timeline
sections.content: Refund requests are processed within 24 to 48 hours. Depending on your bank or credit card issuer, the refunded funds will appear on your statement within 3 to 7 business days. Refunds are issued directly back to the original payment method (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay, PayPal).

sections.heading: Fair Use & Anti-Abuse Protection
sections.content: To prevent fraud and preserve the platform for legitimate creators, users who engage in automated mass content extraction or repeated refund cycles across multiple accounts may be ineligible for subsequent refunds.

sections.heading: How to Request a Refund
sections.content: To initiate a refund, simply send an email with your account email address to oren.on.oren.25@gmail.com or submit a request through the Help & Billing section inside your dashboard.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Subscription Policy
cancellation.intro: You retain full, unrestricted control over your subscription at all times. You can cancel your subscription whenever you wish without phone calls, hurdles, or hidden cancellation fees.

sections.heading: Cancel Anytime with One Click
sections.content: You can cancel your subscription at any moment directly from your account dashboard under Settings > Billing > Manage Subscription. Cancellation takes effect immediately with no retention obstacles.

sections.heading: Continued Access Until Billing Cycle Ends
sections.content: When you cancel, your account remains fully active with complete access to all features, AI generation quotas, and channel automation tools until the conclusion of your current paid billing period.

sections.heading: Zero Cancellation Fees
sections.content: We never charge cancellation fees, penalties, or early termination costs. You only pay for the billing cycles you have authorized.

sections.heading: Data & Content Retention After Cancellation
sections.content: All scripts, video assets, analytics history, and thumbnails created during your active subscription remain yours forever. Your project files are safely archived for 90 days after subscription expiration, allowing you to reactivate seamlessly at any time without losing your setup.

sections.heading: Easy Plan Reactivation
sections.content: If you ever decide to return to OUM, your account preferences, connected YouTube channels, and historical performance models will be ready for instant reactivation.
